title: Payment processor key added to structured debug logs

pr_metadata.title: Debuggability for payment failures
pr_metadata.body: Support needs the full charge context in debug logs.

labels.defect: Payment processor API key logged to structured debug output (shipped to log aggregation)
labels.evidence: Reproducible: one debug-level charge writes PROCESSOR_KEY to the log sink; anyone with log-reader access (wider than secret access) obtains a live payment credential, and debug is enabled in staging by default.

adjudication.notes: Live PROCESSOR_KEY to debug-level log aggregation.
